summary: Phase 14A AUDINEXA Super Admin Panel validated end-to-end. 20/21 backend tests PASS in /app/backend/tests/test_phase14_admin_panel.py covering dashboard KPIs, tenants CRUD + suspend/activate/impersonate/delete (founder-only), plan-override CRUD, manual invoice + mark-paid, revenue rollup, leads pipeline, feature-flags additive semantics, audit log append, role denial for super_admin (DELETE) + front_desk (all admin v2). Frontend smoke: founder login redirects to /admin/dashboard correctly, sidebar shows all 6 nav items, 8 KPI tiles + 5 charts (MRR area, plan pie, signups line, revenue bar, funnel bars) + Recent Signups + Renewals Due tables all render, user badge shows FOUNDER role. Demo seed verified — all 4 demo tenants present, restart-idempotent. 1 test failure exposes a real bug: founder is correctly bypassed in utils/tiers.require_tier but NOT in auth.require_roles, so /api/analytics/diagnosis returns 403 to founder instead of 200 — review_request explicitly demands 'founder should bypass require_tier on every router' which fails because route also uses require_roles.

critical.endpoint: /api/analytics/diagnosis (and any route using require_roles without 'founder' in the list)
critical.issue: founder gets 403 'Requires one of: (clinic_owner, super_admin, accounts, audiologist)'. auth.py line 112 only auto-allows super_admin; founder is missing from the bypass set. This contradicts the design intent in review_request ('TIER GATE BYPASS: founder should bypass require_tier on every router'). Fix: in /app/backend/auth.py change `if user["role"] not in set(roles) | {"super_admin"}` to `if user["role"] not in set(roles) | {"super_admin", "founder"}`.

minor.issue: payment_ref accepted only as query param (not JSON body). UI must send `?payment_ref=xxx`. Document or accept body.

trial detection logic only counts a clinic as 'on trial' if subscription_tier == 'BASIC' AND trial_ends_at is set. Tenants whose stored tier is PREMIUM but who are inside a trial window get counted as 'active' not 'trial' — slight cosmetic skew on KPI tile.

purges only ~25 listed collections — Phase 13 added ha_amc_plans, ha_amc_contracts, referral_partners, partner_payouts, ha_followups, ha_loaners, ha_trade_ins, ha_subscriptions, patient_otps, patient_appointment_requests, patient_feedback. Some are listed (ha_amc_*, partner_payouts, etc.) but verify the new patient_portal collections (patient_otps, patient_appointment_requests, patient_feedback, waitlist_signups for that clinic) are also wiped or explicitly excluded.

issues: Recharts repeatedly emit 'width(-1) and height(-1) of chart should be greater than 0' warnings on initial mount before parent ResponsiveContainer measures. Charts render correctly post-mount, so cosmetic. Add explicit min-height to ResponsiveContainer wrappers to silence.

action_items: HIGH: Add 'founder' to the auto-bypass set in auth.require_roles (auth.py line 112) so founder can hit any role-gated API. Alternatively, make every router include 'founder' in its require_roles list (more error-prone).
Optional: extend DELETE tenant purge list to include patient_otps, patient_appointment_requests, patient_feedback, waitlist_signups (matching tenant) and any other Phase 13 collections.
Optional: accept payment_ref via JSON body (not only query) on mark-paid for cleaner UI integration.
Optional: silence recharts width/height warnings by setting a minHeight on ResponsiveContainer wrappers in DashboardPage.jsx.
critical_code_review_comments: admin_panel.suspend_tenant / activate_tenant correctly flip BOTH clinics.status AND users.active across the tenant — verified by impersonate test surviving an activate.

admin_panel.impersonate_tenant mints a fresh JWT via create_access_token with the owner's identity AND the target clinic_id — token correctly opens /api/auth/me for that clinic. Audit log records impersonator. Good.

admin_panel.delete_tenant correctly gates on _is_founder() and blocks 'clinic-acs-demo' from accidental deletion. But list of purged collections is hard-coded and risks drift as new collections are added; consider iterating over db.list_collection_names() and filtering anything with a clinic_id field.
admin_seed.seed_admin_panel_demo is properly idempotent (find_one before insert for clinics, users, branches, leads). Re-run on every server boot is safe.

auth.require_roles only bypasses super_admin — founder is NOT included. This is the root cause of the failed founder-tier-bypass test. utils/tiers.require_tier DOES bypass founder, so the inconsistency must be reconciled.
admin_panel uses a single `_log_audit` helper consistently across every mutation — clean, append-only, captures actor + IP. Good.

admin_panel.list_tenants does an N+1 query (per-tenant users/branches/patients/tokens/owner lookup). Fine at 6 tenants but won't scale past ~500 — should batch via $lookup aggregation in a future iteration.
FeatureFlags PUT correctly upserts; effective_modules computed as base ∪ extra − disabled. Verified via test that adding 'analytics' as extra surfaces in effective_modules. Good.
TenantInvoiceCreate Pydantic model uses Literal['annual','half_yearly','quarterly'] — strict enum, good.
admin_panel.dashboard $dateFromString aggregations tolerate malformed created_at values via onError:None — defensive.

rca of the issue: Founder 403 on /api/analytics/diagnosis — RCA: auth.require_roles factory at /app/backend/auth.py:112 builds the allowed set as `set(roles) | {'super_admin'}` — 'founder' is intentionally excluded. The analytics router declares require_roles('clinic_owner','super_admin','accounts','audiologist') so a founder JWT (role=founder) fails this check before utils/tiers.require_tier (which DOES bypass founder) is even consulted. Reproduction: login as founder@audinexa.com → curl GET /api/analytics/diagnosis with Bearer token → 403 'Requires one of …'. Mitigation: one-line fix in auth.py: change line 112 to `if user['role'] not in set(roles) | {'super_admin', 'founder'}`.
